name: Realistic water and sun
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Enables creating a realistic looking body of water (rectangular surface) from a single command and initializing a realistic sun on the horizon which affects the water reflection. It's also possible to move bodies of water up and down (i.e. for water level puzzles) and moving the sun around (i.e. for a day and night cycle).

Warning! If you have downloaded this plugin directly from the engine, there might be missing files. You can download the missing files from GitHub on the provided link or from the RPG Paper Maker Discord server.

commands.name: Create water surface
commands.description: Create a rectangular water surface on the map

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: ID of the variable to store the water in case you want to move it later

defaultParameters.name: x
defaultParameters.description: X coordinate of the leftmost vertex (west)

defaultParameters.name: y
defaultParameters.description: Height of the water surface (in squares)

defaultParameters.name: z
defaultParameters.description: Z coordinate of the topmost vertex (north)

defaultParameters.name: length
defaultParameters.description: Size of the body of water in the X axis (in squares). If equal to 0, it will max out to match the map size

defaultParameters.name: width
defaultParameters.description: Size of the body of water in the Z axis (in squares). If equal to 0, it will max out to match the map size

commands.name: Move water surface
commands.description: Assign a new value to the Y (height) coordinate of a given surface

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: ID of the variable that holds this body of water

defaultParameters.name: y
defaultParameters.description: The surface will teleport to the given Y coordinate (height)

defaultParameters.name: elevation
defaultParameters.description: Sun elevation, in degrees (between 0 and 90, 0 being the horizon and 90 fully above the scene)

defaultParameters.name: azimuth
defaultParameters.description: Horizontal position of the sun, in degrees from the center of the map
